name: OpenAI Image
description: OpenAI draws the picture of a Generated Image. The key is in the OpenAI settings.

properties.name: imageModel
properties.title: Image Model
properties.description: The OpenAI image models your API key may use, as OpenAI lists them (DALL·E is retired). gpt-image-2 and later draw in the panel's own shape; older models draw a fixed size, shown with a blurred margin.

properties.name: quality
properties.title: Quality
properties.description: Higher costs more. A model that does not offer the level chosen uses the nearest one below it (Extra high and Maximum are gpt-image-2.5's).

properties.name: moderation
properties.title: Moderation
properties.description: How strictly OpenAI filters what it draws: auto is its standard filter, low is less strict.
